id: 01_From Chemical Safety Rules to Risk Management ACS College Safety Video 1
title: 从化学安全规则到风险管理
source_doc: course/ACS College Lab Safety Series/01_From Chemical Safety Rules to Risk Management ACS College Safety Video 1.md
author_source: project/ACS College Lab Safety Series/01_From Chemical Safety Rules to Risk Management ACS College Safety Video 1/src.py

points.K1: 防护装备也要按风险来选
points.K5: 硫酸：有用的性质也是危害
points.K6: 操作程序也会带来危害
points.K7: 风险＝严重程度×暴露可能
points.K8: 一滴和一大摊：用量决定风险
points.K9: 乙醚：在哪儿用决定风险
points.K10: 把风险降到可接受水平
points.K13: 风险不能消除，只能降低

shots.scene: 欣欣站在化学教学实验室里向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a chemistry teaching lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲从安全规则到风险管理。
overlay: 从化学安全规则到风险管理

shots.scene: 四个图标排成一行：放大镜、天平、向下箭头、急救箱
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a magnifying glass, a balance scale, a down arrow over a warning triangle, and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 识别、评估、降低、准备，四步走。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一张空白规则清单，轻松地晃了晃
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a lab coat holds up a blank rule checklist and waves it casually with a confident smile.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：这些规则高中早就背熟了。

shots.scene: 小研指着实验台上一套新的加热装置，阿杰挠头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a new heating setup on the bench; the young male student scratches his head, puzzled.
shots.narration: 可新实验没写在清单上，怎么办？

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 光背规则不够，要学会管理风险。

shots.section_title: 防护装备也要按风险来选
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰穿实验服、戴护目镜和手套，站在实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student stand at a lab bench wearing lab coats, safety goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 片中的防护装备，是按风险评估选的。
overlay: 防护装备也要按风险来选

shots.section_title: 防护装备也要按风险来选
shots.scene: 欣欣不穿实验服，站在只有清洁空玻璃器皿的实验台后
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot without a lab coat stands behind a lab bench holding only clean empty glassware and no reagent bottles.
shots.narration: 主持人不戴防护时，化学品都已撤走。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻看一本空白的高中笔记本
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flips through a blank old school notebook with simple flask doodles.
shots.narration: 高中学过的规则，大学还会再听到。

shots.scene: 一级台阶上再加一级台阶的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a staircase: a small step with a checklist icon and a higher step with a lightbulb icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这次我们要在规则之上再进一步。

shots.scene: 欣欣手捧一个发光的灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a glowing lightbulb in both paws.
shots.narration: 掌握原则，遇到新情况也不慌。

shots.scene: 一张空白规则卡旁出现一个调节旋钮
shots.prompt_en: A blank rule card next to an adjustment dial icon turning slightly. No people.
shots.narration: 不同实验，通用规则要按风险来调整。

shots.scene: 四个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four icons light up one by one: a magnifying glass, a balance scale, a down arrow, and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 先识别危害，再评估风险，

shots.scene: 后两个图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The last two icons light up: a down arrow over a warning triangle and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 然后降低风险，做好应急准备。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着放大镜看实验台
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks across a lab bench through a large magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 第一步：识别危害。

shots.scene: 危害定义：一个警示三角指向小人
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle icon with an arrow pointing toward a small person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 危害，就是能伤害你的东西。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶、加热仪器、操作流程箭头三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a reagent bottle with a blank label, a hot plate, and a flow chart of arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品、仪器和操作程序都可能有危害。

shots.section_title: 硫酸：有用的性质也是危害
shots.scene: 欣欣换上实验服、戴护目镜手套，旁边是一瓶硫酸
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot in a lab coat, goggles and gloves stands beside a reagent bottle with a blank label and a corrosion pictogram.
shots.narration: 比如硫酸，能和很多物质发生反应。
overlay: 硫酸：有用的性质也是危害

shots.section_title: 硫酸：有用的性质也是危害
shots.scene: 戴手套的手扶着烧杯，旁边腐蚀性象形图和红斑手图标
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand steadies a beaker; beside it a corrosion pictogram and a simple hand icon with a red burn mark.
shots.narration: 它同样会和皮肤反应，造成化学灼伤。

shots.section_title: 硫酸：有用的性质也是危害
shots.scene: 一枚硬币两面：一面是烧瓶，一面是警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A coin icon flipping: one side shows a flask, the other side a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 让它有用的性质，恰恰也是危害。

shots.section_title: 操作程序也会带来危害
shots.scene: 加热搅拌器上的烧杯冒出红色热浪
shots.prompt_en: A beaker on a stirring hot plate with red heat wave ripples rising around it, a gloved hand nearby.
shots.narration: 有时，危害来自操作程序。
overlay: 操作程序也会带来危害

shots.section_title: 操作程序也会带来危害
shots.scene: 加热板旁放着带火焰象形图的试剂瓶，警示三角闪烁
shots.prompt_en: A hot plate next to a bottle with a flame pictogram, with a flashing yellow warning triangle between them. No people.
shots.narration: 要加热，热源就是危害，易燃更危险。

shots.section_title: 风险＝严重程度×暴露可能
shots.scene: 欣欣举着天平图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a balance scale icon.
shots.narration: 第二步：评估风险。
overlay: 风险＝严重程度×暴露可能

shots.section_title: 风险＝严重程度×暴露可能
shots.scene: 一个骰子图标旁有小人
shots.prompt_en: A dice icon next to a small person pictogram with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 风险，是被危害伤到的可能性。

shots.section_title: 风险＝严重程度×暴露可能
shots.scene: 危险的试剂瓶盖紧放在架上，旁边打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A tightly capped bottle with a warning pictogram resting on a shelf, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 有危害，不一定就有很大的风险。

shots.section_title: 风险＝严重程度×暴露可能
shots.scene: 公式图：警示三角乘以骰子等于风险表
shots.prompt_en: A simple equation made of icons: a warning triangle, a multiplication sign, a dice, an equals sign, and a gauge meter. No people.
shots.narration: 风险等于危害严重程度乘暴露可能。

shots.section_title: 一滴和一大摊：用量决定风险
shots.scene: 一瓶贴腐蚀和氧化象形图的空白标签试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a blank label showing a corrosion pictogram and an oxidizer pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 浓硝酸既是强酸，又是强氧化剂。
overlay: 一滴和一大摊：用量决定风险

shots.section_title: 一滴和一大摊：用量决定风险
shots.scene: 戴手套的手用滴管在台面滴一滴清水
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand uses a dropper to place a single small drop of water on a lab bench.
shots.narration: 一滴好控制，沾到皮肤也容易冲掉。

shots.section_title: 一滴和一大摊：用量决定风险
shots.scene: 量筒倒在台面，清水流成一大摊
shots.prompt_en: A graduated cylinder tips over on a lab bench and water spreads into a large puddle, top-down view.
shots.narration: 要是50毫升洒到腿上，暴露就大了。

shots.section_title: 一滴和一大摊：用量决定风险
shots.scene: 风险表指针从低摆向高
shots.prompt_en: A gauge meter with the needle swinging from the green low zone to the red high zone. No people.
shots.narration: 用多少、怎么用，决定风险高低。

shots.section_title: 乙醚：在哪儿用决定风险
shots.scene: 带易燃象形图的试剂瓶，瓶口飘出淡淡的蒸气
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a flame pictogram and a blank label, faint vapor drifting from the open neck. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醚的蒸气，不宜吸入。
overlay: 乙醚：在哪儿用决定风险

shots.section_title: 乙醚：在哪儿用决定风险
shots.scene: 小研在开放台面倒液，蒸气飘起，旁边红色拇指向下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles pours a liquid on an open bench, white vapor dots rising, with a red thumbs-down icon beside her.
shots.narration: 在开放台面上用，吸入风险大。

shots.section_title: 乙醚：在哪儿用决定风险
shots.scene: 小研在通风橱内倒液，旁边绿色拇指向上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles pours a liquid inside a chemical fume hood, with a green thumbs-up icon beside her.
shots.narration: 放进通风橱，吸入的可能大大降低。

shots.section_title: 把风险降到可接受水平
shots.scene: 欣欣站在风险表旁，指针停在绿色区
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large gauge meter with the needle resting in the green zone.
shots.narration: 所有实验，都有一定的风险。
overlay: 把风险降到可接受水平

shots.section_title: 把风险降到可接受水平
shots.scene: 风险表指针从红区降到绿区，旁边打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A gauge meter needle moving down from the red zone to the green zone, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 风险降到可接受，多数实验能安全做。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a big down arrow icon.
shots.narration: 第三步：降低风险。

shots.scene: 小研在通风橱内倾倒液体，有害气体被吸走
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours a liquid inside a fume hood while gray fumes are drawn up and away.
shots.narration: 进通风橱，是为了不吸入有害气体。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a pair of safety goggles.
shots.narration: 戴护目镜，防止腐蚀性物质伤眼。

shots.scene: 小研穿好实验服，戴上手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles buttons her lab coat and pulls on gloves.
shots.narration: 可能伤到皮肤，就戴手套穿实验服。

shots.scene: 小研看着四张空白卡片思考
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student thinks in front of four blank cards floating beside her.
shots.narration: 减少暴露，还可以问自己四个问题。

shots.scene: 两个试剂瓶，危害大的被换成危害小的
shots.prompt_en: Two bottles: one with a red warning pictogram slides away and is replaced by one with a green leaf icon. No people.
shots.narration: 能不能换一种危害小的化学品？

shots.scene: 两只锥形瓶各配一个危害表，浓的指针在高，稀的在低
shots.prompt_en: Two flasks side by side, each with a small hazard gauge; the left gauge points to high, the right gauge points to low. No people.
shots.narration: 能不能用低浓度？12M换成1M。

shots.scene: 大烧杯换成小试管
shots.prompt_en: A large beaker icon shrinking into a small test tube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 能不能少用一点？

shots.scene: 温度计读数下降
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with the red column dropping and a down arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 能不能降低温度，减少烫伤？

shots.section_title: 风险不能消除，只能降低
shots.scene: 风险表指针压到最低，但没有归零
shots.prompt_en: A gauge meter with the needle pushed to the lowest green mark but not at zero. No people.
shots.narration: 风险不可能完全消除，
overlay: 风险不能消除，只能降低

shots.section_title: 风险不能消除，只能降低
shots.scene: 欣欣认真点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods seriously with paws together.
shots.narration: 但能而且应当始终降到最低。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起急救箱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a first aid kit.
shots.narration: 第四步：应急准备。

shots.scene: 戴护目镜的小研用ABC灭火器扑灭通风橱内烧杯上的小火
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles uses a fire extinguisher to put out a small flame on a beaker inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 出事了你准备好了吗？会灭火吗？

shots.scene: 戴手套的手用吸附垫吸干量筒洒出的液体
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand presses an absorbent pad onto liquid spilled from a tipped graduated cylinder.
shots.narration: 洒了液体，你会处理吗？

shots.scene: 小研在实验前对着空白笔记本思考，头顶浮现问号
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits at a desk with a blank notebook before the experiment, a thought bubble with a question mark above her.
shots.narration: 主动想想实验可能出什么错，

shots.scene: 小研点头，把灭火器和吸附垫摆在手边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student nods and places a fire extinguisher and absorbent pads within reach of her bench.
shots.narration: 然后做好应对的准备。

shots.scene: 实验楼全景，许多人在各自岗位上
shots.prompt_en: A wide view of a campus lab building with several people working at their benches.
shots.narration: 你学到的安全，深受学校文化影响。

shots.scene: 许多手共同托起一个盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Many hands together holding up a shield icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 好的安全文化，需要你尽一份力。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five floating icons: a heart, a hard hat, a crossed-out dice, a megaphone, and a hand on a shield.
shots.narration: 安全伦理，先从正确的态度开始。

shots.scene: 阿杰想抄近路的念头气泡被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shakes his head at a thought bubble showing a shortcut arrow, which is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 重视安全、安全工作，不冒险。

shots.scene: 小研提醒阿杰把护目镜戴好，阿杰点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reminds the young male student to adjust his goggles; he nods and fixes them.
shots.narration: 推动安全，为安全承担起责任。

shots.scene: 书本、扳手、心形三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an open book, a wrench, and a heart. No people.
shots.narration: 用化学品的人，都需要知识技能和态度。

shots.scene: 欣欣把盾牌图标放在书堆最上面
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot places a shield icon on top of a stack of blank textbooks.
shots.narration: 把安全放在首位，会让你终身受益。

shots.scene: 三个问号气泡
shots.prompt_en: Three speech bubbles with question marks floating over a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 安全远不只是遵守规则。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开一本空白的系列课程目录
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a blank course booklet with numbered tabs.
shots.narration: 这些问题，后面几课会一一展开。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁四个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four icons lighting up: a magnifying glass, a balance scale, a down arrow, and a first aid kit.
shots.narration: 识别、评估、降低、准备，四步走。

shots.scene: 公式图标：严重程度乘暴露可能
shots.prompt_en: An icon equation: a warning triangle times a dice equals a gauge meter. No people.
shots.narration: 风险看严重程度，也看暴露可能。

shots.scene: 换、稀、少、冷四张卡片打勾
shots.prompt_en: Four small cards with green check marks: a swap arrow, a pale flask, a small test tube, and a cool thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 换、稀、少、冷，把风险降到最低。

shots.scene: 许多手托起盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Many hands holding up a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安全文化，人人有份。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的实验台前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of a tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 管住风险，安全实验，谢谢观看！
